dsl.file.encoding: The file is not UTF-8 encoded
dsl.yaml.duplicate_key: Duplicate key {key}; it first appears on line {line}
dsl.yaml.key_not_string: Keys must be strings; quote numbers and true/false when using them as keys
dsl.yaml.recursive: An alias cannot refer to itself
dsl.yaml.too_large: More than {limit} nodes after expanding aliases
dsl.choice.suggest: {value} is not allowed. Did you mean {suggestion}?
dsl.choice.many: {value} is not allowed; run rpa schema to see the allowed values
dsl.schema_version: schemaVersion {value} is not supported; the current version is {current}
dsl.type.string: Must be a string; quote numbers and true/false
dsl.greater_than_equal: Must be greater than or equal to {ge}
dsl.less_than_equal: Must be less than or equal to {le}
dsl.format.slug: {value} has the wrong format: use lowercase letters, digits, - and _, start with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters
dsl.format.identifier: {value} has the wrong format: use letters, digits and _, do not start with a digit, at most 64 characters
dsl.format.secret_name: {value} has the wrong format: use uppercase letters, digits and _, start with a letter, for example ERP_PASSWORD
dsl.format.file_name: {value} has the wrong format: use letters, digits, ., - and _, start with a letter or digit, at most 100 characters
dsl.locator.no_strategy: Specify one way to locate the element: {choices}
dsl.locator.multiple_strategies: Specify only one way to locate the element, found: {fields}; put alternatives in fallback
dsl.locator.name_requires_role: name can only be used with role; {strategy} already matches text
dsl.locator.exact_requires_name: exact only has an effect when role is used with name
dsl.locator.nested_fallback: A fallback locator cannot have its own fallback
dsl.one_of.many: Specify only one of these fields, found: {fields}
dsl.url.invalid: {value} is not a valid URL: start with http:// or https://, or start with / and set browser.baseUrl
dsl.url.invalid_base: {value} is not a valid URL: start with http:// or https://
dsl.url.relative_without_base: {value} is a relative path; set the site URL in browser.baseUrl first
dsl.expect.page_check_with_target: {field} checks the whole page and cannot be used with target
dsl.expect.match_not_applicable: match only applies to text, value, url and title, not to {field}
dsl.extract.attribute_required: When get is attribute, name the attribute with attribute, for example href
dsl.extract.fields_with_get: With fields, each field sets its own get
dsl.extract.table_conflict: {field} cannot be used when get is table
dsl.screenshot.full_page_with_target: fullPage cannot be used with target (element screenshot)
dsl.step.duplicate_id: Step id {id} is already used by step {first}
dsl.template.undeclared_secrets: Uses the undeclared secret {name}; add it to secrets
dsl.value.range: The upper limit cannot be less than the lower limit
dsl.value.default_invalid: The default value does not satisfy {rule}
dsl.verify.constant_value: value must use {{{{ }}}} to refer to what is checked, for example {{{{ facts.name }}}}
dsl.verify.required_for_outputs: Scenarios with outputs need verify: outputs are published only after the independent assertions pass
dsl.output.from_required: Output {name} needs from to say where its value comes from, for example {{{{ facts.name }}}}
dsl.format.script_path: {value} is not a valid script path: use a relative path inside the scenario folder ending in .py, without ..
dsl.script.verify_not_allowed: Python script scenarios are asserted by assertion.py; leave out verify
dsl.script.output_from_not_allowed: Outputs of Python script scenarios come from assertion.py; leave out from
dsl.script.missing: Script {value} not found (relative to the scenario file's folder)
dsl.extract.duplicate_as: facts.{name} is already produced by step {first}
dsl.template.undeclared_inputs: Uses the undeclared input {name}; add it to inputs
dsl.template.unknown_fact: No extract produces facts.{name}; extract it in a step with as: {name}
dsl.template.fact_not_yet: facts.{name} is only produced by a later extract step
dsl.template.facts_unavailable: No page facts exist yet here, so facts cannot be used
